overview: The Deep Fungal Tunnels are the oldest and darkest part of Fungus Grove.
details: These tunnels predate the Shik’Nar and Shak Dratha hives. Ancient fungal networks pulse with alien intelligence, corruption engines twist spores into lethal forms, and the Buried Godling sleeps in the deepest chamber.
hooks: A corruption engine destabilizes, threatening a tunnel collapse.
Shak Dratha hive-priests attempt a deep communion ritual.
Shik’Nar tunnelers breach a forbidden chamber.
The Buried Godling stirs, warping nearby fungal networks.
